method: Each question was compared with page renders of the official PDF (SHA-256 checked), zooming in on rebuilt maths, and with the pdftotext text layer. Each stored answer was checked against the bank's Answer Key (PDF pp. 47-82) and worked through independently.

source.notes: File 2025_04_CFQ-ISC-Mathematics-XII.pdf from cisce.org; the SHA-256 matches. The title, ISC Class XII Mathematics, the 7 sections and the section marks match the pack. The preface is dated August 2024. 18 questions with a null chapter (economics calculus/regression) are not loaded and were not reviewed.
